facts.about: Trent Ltd is engaged in retailing of apparels, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery & non food products through various of its retail formats/ concepts.

flags.text: Operating leverage: profit +63%/yr vs sales +35%/yr over 3 years
Operating margin expanded 5 pts in 3 years (14% → 19%)
Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 123% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+22%) well below 3-yr trend (+35%)

business.summary: Trent Ltd is a lifestyle retailer operating brands like Westside, Zudio, Samoh, and Burnt Toast. It offers fashion, beauty, and lifestyle products through a direct-to-consumer model, leveraging an integrated supply chain and technology to scale its store and online presence.

segments.name: Fashion and Lifestyle
segments.note: Includes brands like Westside, Zudio, Samoh, and Burnt Toast.

segments.name: Food and Grocery (Star)
segments.note: Focuses on exclusive own brands in FMCG and fresh foods.

narrative.scoreline: Management has successfully translated scale into significant margin expansion and cash flow, despite a visible cooling in top-line growth rates.
bull: Operating margins expanded 500 basis points over three years to reach 19% in FY26.
Cash flow from operations is exceptionally strong, representing 123% of net profit over five years.
Debt-to-equity remains conservative at 0.30x despite aggressive scale-up to ₹20,000 cr annual revenue.
bear: Revenue growth has slowed significantly from 39.4% in Sep 2024 to 21.9% in Sep 2026.
Free cash flow of ₹931 cr in FY26 is lower than the ₹955 cr achieved in FY24.
Inventory valuation remains a key audit risk given the high-volume retail nature of the business.
watch: Monitor if Sep 2026 revenue growth of 21.9% signals a permanent shift to lower growth.

risks.text: Contingent liabilities exist for indirect taxes, income tax, and various claims filed against the company.
Related party transactions are conducted at arm's length in the ordinary course of business.
Inventory existence and valuation are key audit matters due to high volumes and retail nature.
Key financial processes are highly dependent on information systems and automated controls.
